verdict.rationale: WorkOS ships an official CLI, but only for a narrow purpose (Auth0 migration) — 'The fastest way to export Auth0 data is with the WorkOS CLI migrations tool' — with no evidence of a general-purpose CLI for managing WorkOS resources or AI-native agentic workflows. Missing for 10: a general-purpose management CLI, CLI docs beyond migration, and evidence of AI-agent-oriented CLI usage (the MCP server is a separate, non-CLI agent interface).
